label: I
name: F=MA
tagline: Mechanics fundamentals for the qualifying exam

modules.title: Vectors & Essential Math
modules.description: Vector algebra, dot and cross products, and the small calculus toolkit that olympiad problems assume.

modules.title: Kinematics in One Dimension
modules.description: Motion graphs, constant acceleration, and choosing the right kinematic description.

modules.title: Projectile Motion
modules.description: 2D trajectories, range optimization, and projectiles on inclines, with an interactive trajectory lab.

modules.title: Forces & Free Body Diagrams
modules.description: Systematic force analysis: normal forces, tension, friction, and drawing a clean free body diagram.

modules.title: Circular Motion & Gravitation
modules.description: Centripetal acceleration, banked curves, orbits, and Kepler's laws.

modules.title: Energy & Momentum
modules.description: Work-energy theorem, conservation laws, collisions in one and two dimensions, and center of mass.

modules.title: Rotational Dynamics
modules.description: Torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum, and rolling without slipping.

modules.title: Simple Harmonic Motion
modules.description: Springs, pendulums, effective potentials, and small-oscillation approximations, with a live oscillator.

label: II
name: USAPhO
tagline: Free-response mastery across all of physics

modules.title: Electrostatics & Gauss's Law
modules.description: Field and potential of charge distributions, Gauss's law symmetry arguments, and conductors.

modules.title: Circuits & RC Dynamics
modules.description: Kirchhoff's laws, equivalent resistance tricks, capacitor transients, and infinite ladders.

modules.title: Magnetism & Induction
modules.description: Biot-Savart, Ampere's law, Faraday induction, and motional EMF.

modules.title: Kinetic Theory & Ideal Gases
modules.description: Microscopic pressure derivation, equipartition, and the ideal gas law from first principles.

modules.title: Cycles, Engines & Entropy
modules.description: PV diagrams, Carnot efficiency, entropy bookkeeping, and real cycle analysis.

modules.title: Waves & Interference
modules.description: Standing waves, beats, Doppler effect, and two-source interference.

modules.title: Geometric & Wave Optics
modules.description: Lens systems, mirror equations, diffraction gratings, and thin-film interference.

modules.title: Relativity & Quantum
modules.description: Special relativity kinematics, photoelectric effect, Bohr model, and de Broglie waves.
